title: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that…
description: Delta Sharing reference server versions 1.4.0 up to but not including 1.5.0 contain a permission assignment vulnerability. This flaw allows share recipients with valid bearer tokens to access unshared data by exploiting container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Specifically, recipients can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read all blobs in the storage container, including those not intended to be shared.
